checks.item: Two write routes and distinct records
checks.evidence: Separate scalar-1.nc and scalar-2.nc files are defined through the actual public backend. Route1 writes through ext_ncd_write_field with padded order 0; route2 writes through direct FieldIO with order 0. Both write -17 then 2033 at distinct dates(1)/dates(2), checking each Status.
Variable rank must be one, unlimited Time length and handle TimeIndex must equal each record ordinal, and actual stored date and low-level integer readback must exactly equal their expected values.
Each file is closed/reopened; actual selected wrapper must return NDim0/order0 into a padded buffer. Public ext_ncd_read_field reads both records, each checked against its distinct value.

Direct Length=[0,-1,0,-9] and public unused start1/end0 are intentional scalar controls. GetDim(0) gives NDim0; ANY(Length(1:0)<1) is false. GetIndices initializes synthetic scalar indices to one and returns before accessing unused axes. This grants no exemption to nonpositive active-axis lengths.

Unique SCALAR_RECORD_CONTRACT_PASS marker is required before scalar coverage flags are persisted. Existing normal/negative helper and ZZ gates remain; no extra compiler/child launch was added to the runner.
